messages:
oliver: Quick ping — PR #83520 (routing-cache short-circuit + kv-prefetch) needs runtime + security eyes before I schedule a canary. Plan to cut Tue AM. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/83520 @raj @zoe-sec @maria

raj: I can do a perf skim. Can you paste the p50/p95 before/after from the perf harness? Also what's the seq length mix?

oliver: Quick numbers I ran locally — small bump: p50 +3%, p95 ~no change. Seq mix ~ 8/32/128. Command I used:
```bash
./bench --model=open-xxl --qps=200 --seq-distribution="8:0.5,32:0.3,128:0.2"
```

raj: ok i'll run it on the infra cluster and post exact deltas (ETA ~2h)

zoe-sec: I'll review the security surface. I noticed a KMS rotation snippet in the diff — is that enabled by default? cc @maria

oliver: KMS rotation is behind `--rotate-kms=false` by default. It's only used for private deploys; hosted path unchanged. Should have flagged that in the PR summary, my bad.

maria: Platform note: we need a canary owner + a rollback plan documented before we cut traffic. @sujan can you own Tue morning canary? Also is telemetry gate included so we can alert on regressions?

sujan: I can take Tue 09:00-11:00 PT. I'll watch latency + errors. Rollback plan: revert traffic and pin previous model variant (steps in PR desc). I'll also post a short runbook. :thumbsup:

raj: ran cluster bench on g8-medium — results: p50 +2.8%, p95 +0.5%, CPU +4%. Short output:
```text
p50: baseline 28ms -> 28.8ms
p95: baseline 92ms -> 92.5ms
CPU: 64% -> 68%
```

raj: I'm okay with a 10% canary if we keep telemetry gating on `model_infer_latency` and `rpc_error_rate`.

zoe-sec: Skim complete. No authz/KMS leakage. Please add a one-line note in the PR about the conditional KMS flag and update the changelog; i'll mark security approved after that.

oliver: Added KMS note + changelog entry to PR. CI already passed earlier.

deploy-bot: CI status: all checks passed (build/ci). Auto-merge is disabled until owners set.

oliver: Final checklist: runtime perf eyes (raj) ✅, security (zoe-sec) pending changelog note (done) ✅, canary owner (sujan) ✅. I'll schedule Tue 09:00 PT canary at 10% traffic, rollback ready. Thanks all.

maria: Thanks — please ping #oncall during the canary if you need an expedited rollback.

sujan: Will post the canary runbook and the exact telemetry alerts we'll watch in the PR before Tue.

oliver: Closing the loop — tagging approvals in PR and scheduling the canary.
